item.subject: maths
item.stem:
The diagram shows point $P$, line $L$, and points $F$ and $Q$ on $L$. Segment $PF$ meets $L$ at right angles. Segment $PQ$ is slanted.

Which two claims correctly describe the perpendicular projection of $P$ onto $L$?

options.A: The foot $F$ is the perpendicular projection of $P$ onto $L$.
options.B: Call the answer plane only, with no choice between $F$ and $Q$.
options.C: $PF$ is shorter than $PQ$ because the perpendicular segment is the shortest path from $P$ to $L$.
options.D: Point $Q$ is the projection because $Q$ is the rightmost labelled point on $L$.
